reply: 4 calls. The data is scattered rather than gridded, and a linear fit on a broad basis got to about 1e-6 but was overfit with 20 terms. Non-monotone behaviour at low T and the fitted exponents (T^1.5·√eps, exp(−~1.1·eps), T^0.5) hint at sqrt terms, but I did not find a closed form that captures them.
